title: The public event page is a full Frequency event page: the event's own blurred cover as the backdrop, a poster with a date chip, the facts and going count beside the RSVP box, About, Where with the map, and an event chat that asks a visitor to join

source.ref: Owner 2026-10-14 on the public event page: ok but not great; the background is wrong and it needs all the info with RSVP (social proof), map, chat box (pop up to join) and a killer best practice event design with Frequency vibes.

detail: FqPublicEventBody drew a light split card on the Commons pastel with About and Where only. It now opens its own kit scope full width with the event's cover, blurred under a night scrim, as the backdrop of the top of the page; on it a 4:5 poster with the mode tag and a calendar chip (eventDateBadge) beside the kicker, a display-size title, the when, where and host lines with icons, the going count with an iridescent stack, and the join box in a solid card anchored at #rsvp. Below, About and Where (FqEventMap at the venue's point, passed only when the host left the address visible) sit in solid panels, then PublicEventChat: the chat's shape and a Say hi box whose tap opens a dialog to join free or RSVP as a guest; no member's words are read on the public, ISR page. The page still makes no request read.
